phase_name: Typed Authority Model Production Consumer Independent Verification
summary: Independently re-derived and adversarially verified TAMPC-001 v1.0's production Typed Authority Model consumer (pcae authority inspect <path>) built by Phase 137K, without treating 137K's report, decisions, or test suite as an oracle. Verified consumer identity (exactly one production entry point), module boundary and dependency direction, validation-pipeline precedence (including a fresh multi-defect ordering attack), all sixteen Stage 3 record families, package-resource resolution (fresh wheel build installed into an isolated venv and run from /tmp outside the repository checkout), manifest/registry failure handling, duplicate-key rejection (including fresh deep-nested and discriminator-field fixtures), typed-model construction discipline, immutability (including object.__setattr__ bypass reachability, confirmed as documented and out of TAMPC-001's threat model), provenance field completeness, authority-neutral disclosure, CLI behavior, output determinism, failure taxonomy, side-effect freedom, and packaging. Found and repaired two independently-demonstrated Blocking defects: (1) the module was missing the TAMC_CONTRACT_VERSION constant and output field required by TAMPC-REQ-023/097/153; (2) __all__ exported four names beyond TAMPC-REQ-023's frozen nine-name public-API list. Both repaired by the smallest affected surface (added constant/field, renamed four names to module-private, corrected __all__, updated the two dependent test assertions, added one new regression test) and re-verified. Found and left unrepaired one independently-demonstrated Blocking defect requiring a dedicated contract-repair phase: inspect_artifact_at_path's actual signature (path, artifact_bytes, json_output=False) does not match TAMPC-REQ-023's frozen (path, json_output) signature -- empirically confirmed a call matching the frozen signature raises TypeError. The underlying calling-convention ambiguity was identified by the 137J plan itself ("Section 5's open question") but never routed through TAMPC-REQ-177's required contract-repair process across 137J/137K; resolving it is outside this verification phase's own authority per TAMPC-REQ-178. Also independently reproduced, in the governed .venv (Python 3.9.6), that TAMPC-REQ-078's literal dual-immutability-mechanism text (frozen=True plus an explicit __setattr__/__delattr__ override) is impossible to satisfy simultaneously under this Python version's dataclasses implementation -- classified non-blocking since the functional requirement (ordinary mutation rejected) is independently confirmed satisfied by frozen=True alone. Confirmed 15 pre-existing, unrelated test failures in historical Stage 3 wheel-content snapshot guards (tests/test_cltr_authority_136{z,ah,ai,aj,ak,al,am,an,ao,ap,aq,aw}*.py) via git-stash A/B comparison. Runtime remained Observed / observe / unavailable throughout. See docs/PHASE_137L_TYPED_AUTHORITY_MODEL_PRODUCTION_CONSUMER_INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION.md.
tests_added_or_updated: Updated: tests/test_authority_inspect_137k.py -- fixed imports for the two renamed private constants (_REPRESENTATION_ONLY_DISCLOSURE, _MANIFEST_SCHEMA_ID), replaced the hand-enumerated __all__ assertion in test_public_api_surface_exact with one that also asserts every module-level public name not in __all__ is private, and added test_tamc_and_tampc_contract_versions_in_output asserting both contract-version fields render on success and failure outcomes. Fresh, independently-authored adversarial checks performed in this phase outside the committed test suite (documented in the deliverable, not committed as new test files given time-boxing): deep 5-level nested duplicate-key rejection, discriminator-field duplicate-key rejection, multi-simultaneous-defect precedence ordering, object.__setattr__ bypass reachability, copy/deepcopy/pickle behavior, and a full fresh wheel-build-and-isolated-venv packaging run.
